note: Schema characterized from Mongoid model definitions, not live database

ordinal.description: Sort order for photos in collage

custom_aspect.description: True if user manually resized (overrides image aspect)

image_hash.description: SHA1 hash of image bytes for duplicate detection

indexes.name: r_guid_1
indexes.description: Unique index for read-only GUID lookups

indexes.name: rw_guid_1
indexes.description: Unique index for read-write GUID lookups

indexes.name: photos.ordinal_1
indexes.description: Index for sorting embedded photos by ordinal

constraints.guid_collision_prevention: initialize_guids method loops until both r_guid and rw_guid are unique across all collages
constraints.photo_constraint: size = width × height (enforced by set_default_dimensions callback)
constraints.ordinal_sorting: photos array ordered by ordinal ASC via Mongoid embeds_many order clause

find_by_guid.description: Finds collage by either read or write GUID in single query
find_by_guid.sets_write_access: True if guid matches rw_guid, false if matches r_guid

find_by_r_guid.description: Direct lookup by read-only GUID (uses unique index)

find_by_rw_guid.description: Direct lookup by read-write GUID (uses unique index)

guid_uniqueness.rule: All GUIDs (both r_guid and rw_guid) must be unique across entire collection
guid_uniqueness.collision_handling: Regenerate GUIDs in loop until no collision

photo_embedding.rule: Photos are embedded documents, not separate collection
photo_embedding.implication: Photos do not exist independently of collages
photo_embedding.cascade_delete: Deleting collage deletes all embedded photos

size_constraint.rule: For each photo: size = width × height
size_constraint.enforcement: before_save callback recalculates dimensions if constraint violated
size_constraint.validation: Client and server both calculate dimensions using same algorithm

ordinal_ordering.rule: Photos returned in ordinal ASC order
ordinal_ordering.default: If ordinal not set, MongoDB may return in insertion order (undefined)

aspect_ratio_preservation.rule: Grid dimensions chosen to preserve image aspect ratio
aspect_ratio_preservation.exception: If custom_aspect = true, use manually set aspect instead
aspect_ratio_preservation.algorithm: Binary search through prime factors to find nearest aspect match

to_active_storage.hash_verification: Verify SHA1 hash matches after migration to ensure data integrity

to_postgres.challenge: Embedded photos → JOIN table or JSON column
to_postgres.recommended: Keep embedded as PostgreSQL JSONB for similar structure
to_postgres.alternative: Create separate photos table with foreign key to collages
to_postgres.index_impact: JSONB indexes differ from MongoDB embedded document indexes

guid_generation.compatibility: Both generate UUID v4, format identical

performance_notes.guid_lookups: O(1) via unique indexes on r_guid and rw_guid
performance_notes.photo_sorting: O(n log n) but n is small (typically <100 photos per collage)
performance_notes.embedded_photos: Entire collage document loaded at once (no N+1 queries)
performance_notes.duplicate_detection: Requires full collection scan if no index on photos.image_hash
performance_notes.recommended_index: Add index on 'photos.image_hash' for faster duplicate detection

validation_commands.photo_size_validation: mongo collaged_development --eval 'db.collages.find({"photos.size": {$ne: null}, $where: "this.photos.some(p => p.size !== p.width * p.height)"})'
